definition: Scientific label with doubtful meaning used when experts cannot clearly identify the creature it was originally described for.
problems: judge: The definition says the name has 'doubtful meaning' and is 'used when experts cannot clearly identify the creature it was originally described for.' The source only states it is a name 'of unknown or doubtful application' — it does not specify the reason (inability to identify the creature) nor does it say the meaning itself is doubtful.
